name: System Event Notification V 02
definition: Scope|The SystemEventNotification message is sent by a central system to notify the occurrence of an event in a central system.|Usage|The message can be used by a central settlement system to inform its participants of an event that is going to occur in the system, for instance that the system will be down at a certain time, etc.

EventInformation.name: Event Information
EventInformation.definition: Detailed information about a system event.
